object_types.name: Person
object_types.definition: Anyone in the system, identified by a person ID.

source_references.excerpt: We track persons generally -- anyone in the system is a person with a person ID.
anyone in the system is a person with a person ID

object_types.name: Employee
object_types.definition: A person who is employed; every employee is also a person, identified the same way.

source_references.excerpt: Employees are persons; every employee is also a person, identified the same way.

object_types.name: Manager
object_types.definition: An employee with extra responsibilities; every manager is an employee, and through that, a person.

source_references.excerpt: A manager is an employee with extra responsibilities. Every manager is an employee, and through that, a person.

object_types.name: Department
object_types.definition: An organizational unit identified by a department code, with a unique department name.

source_references.excerpt: Each department has a department code.
Each department has a department code.

object_types.name: DepartmentName
object_types.definition: Name of a Department, e.g. Payroll or Field Operations. Unique across departments.

source_references.excerpt: Departments also each have a department name, like "Payroll" or "Field Operations", and no two share a name.
